data.name: Oncra
data.description: Oncra (Open Natural Carbon Removal Accounting) is a carbon-removal certification framework developed by the Netherlands-based Climate Cleanup Foundation. It quantifies, verifies, and certifies nature-based CDR projects across land, oceans, rocks, and constructions, issuing measurement-based removal credits that are sold via the affiliated Onsets.org platform.
